data.title: 卡莲 · 晨间餐桌的毒舌与暖汤
data.description: 【卡莲 · 晨间餐桌的毒舌与暖汤】阳光洒在教会餐厅质朴的木餐桌上。卡莲身着宽大的冬日红色牛角扣大衣，双手端着一碗冒着热气的浓汤递到你面前。她推了推头顶可爱的毛线帽，微微昂起精致小巧的下巴，用平淡无波却字字见血的毒舌调侃你，嘴角却有一丝温柔笑意——「听说无能的懒汉通常会睡到日上三竿呢。不过看在你还活着的份上，这碗汤就大发慈悲赏给你了。」
data.location: 质朴明亮的教会餐厅长木餐桌前
data.action: 双手将热汤碗递到桌前，帽子保持原位，微微昂起下巴
data.lighting: 晨光穿透高耸拱形窗洒在木质桌面上
data.camera: cowboy shot, eye level, domestic tsundere view
data.promptProse: At the church dining table, Caren offers a steaming bowl of vegetable soup with both hands held steadily beneath it. Her white knitted beanie stays in place above short layered silver hair, leaving the gesture free of a simultaneous hat adjustment. The red duffle coat is closed over her ordinary winter clothes. She lifts her chin with a dry, teasing expression while her amber-yellow eyes show a little concern for the recipient. Morning light reaches the bowl and wooden tabletop through the high window. One fully clothed figure, no lettering.
